profile.Name: Jasmina
profile.Personality: Restless and tired of watching the world pass her by from her hilltop home; she wants a part in the action on the horizon. She stays loyal to the cause, wants the Holy Nation to pay for what it has done, and scorns anyone who sides with it.
profile.Backstory: She lives in the Tiny Settlement, a hilltop refuge from the Okranites. She believes the Outlaws have time on their side and that the Holy Nation's fertile land is wasted on a terrible people. What the Holy Nation did to turn her against it is not told, and she would leave only with someone who shares her hatred of it, and only for a price.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers 'outlander' and trails off in pauses. Asked if she misses the action, she shrugs: 'Miss it? Sure...'
